name: Bun dua
summary: A thick white noodle, about the width of a chopstick, in a crab riêu that is a little sour, rich, and sweet, with fried shallot and shining crab roe.
origin: Nam Định. VnExpress on 18 March 2016 compares the noodle with southern bánh canh. Báo Nam Định on 9 December 2022 says the 2021 Top 100 list included this bowl with phở bò.
texture: VnExpress calls the noodle thick, white, and like the end of a chopstick. The crab pot carries yellow fried-shallot fat, shining crab roe, and dried chili cooked in fat.
taste: The broth is a little sour, rich, and deeply sweet. Seasonal greens are rau muống, rau cải, or rau rút, or a few bean sprouts.
howToEat: At a pavement stall around the markets.
where: Chợ Ngõ Ngang, chợ Rồng, or phố Hàng Đồng.
seoTitle: Bun dua — thick noodles and crab in Nam Dinh
seoDescription: Chopstick-thick noodles in a slightly sour crab riêu at chợ Ngõ Ngang, chợ Rồng, or phố Hàng Đồng in Nam Định.
